_comment: Convoy SEARCH mission (NAV-8), profile 'real' (3 HULA drones via pyhulax). The proven SIM-5 convoy mission carried over to the real profile: each drone takeoff (HOLD airborne) -> sentry_scan (stationary rotating observer over the route — zero translational drift, stable hover frames best for ArUco; the convoy re-crosses the footprint). frame_backend 'pyhulax' streams each drone's onboard camera over its OWN shared DroneAPI link (S10); marker_backend 'aruco' is the primary detector (convoy robots carry ArUco markers to detect + READ); detector 'none' (no YOLO). SEPARATION here is the swarm ALTITUDE BAND (1.2/1.7/2.2 m, distinct per drone — the proven SIM-5 model): unlike the Challenge-2A LANDING mission, the search task is NOT under the 1.1 m ceiling and the rotating observers hold STATIONARY footprints, so vertical band separation is the lowest-risk collision guarantee and the band IS each drone's takeoff height (takeoff.from_config / sentry_scan: band*100 cm). The SafetyController launch + landing slots still serialize the shared C2 corridor (takeoff/land), bounded. command_timeout_s 30 / mission_budget_s 500 sized as SIM-5 (3 serialized takeoffs + >=1 convoy-lap of sentry rotation + landing); budget is a MAX (orchestrator exits on all-DONE). To add bearing-pursuit tracking onsite, append "track_convoy" to a drone's phases (it is built + registry-resolvable; left commented OUT here — sentry_scan is the proven default).

guards._comment: launch_slot_wait_s / slot_wait_s: bounded staggered-launch + serialized-landing corridor waits (finite, never a hang). landing_reserve_s 60: MissionClockGuard lands all 60 s before the budget.

drones._comment: alpha — lowest band 1.2 m. phases takeoff -> sentry_scan; revolutions 2 ~ >1 convoy lap. To track instead of just observe: "phases": ["takeoff", "sentry_scan", "track_convoy"].
